body:
Get ready for the ISTQB Foundation exam! Start with our online ISTQB test. Take our online exam to assess your skills. It is a sample ISTQB Foundation Testing exam with 15 multiple-choice questions to test your knowledge. Practise and assess your level online! This exam is based on a real exam paper written by the GASQ centre and the ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level syllabus.

Once you have answered the 15 questions, you will immediately receive your score and results. Don’t wait, test yourself now! Click here to start the test.
